Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Springfield's five selectboard members: Tara Chase, Heather Frahm (Vice Chair), Douglas Johnston, Kristi Morris (Chair), and Michael Schmitt

Town of Springfield, Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (1,357 ballots of 6,562 registered voters; certified by Town Clerk Barbara A. Courchesne and Assistant Town Clerk Carrie M. Kellow): Kristi C. Morris (813 votes) and Douglas Johnston (705) won the two three-year seats over Bryan Stascavage (451); Michael E. Martin's term expired and he did not return
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 149 (Town of Springfield): sec. 23(a): Library Trustees are an elective office

Town of Springfield, Library Trustees page (current): pattrice jones (Chair; elected March 4, 2025, term to 2028), Christine Boardman and Suzette Chivers (elected 2024, terms to 2027), and Geetu Melwani 'Appointed for 1 year term out of a 3 year term' (March 2026 to March 2027). The report shows Melwani was first appointed in 2025 after a resignation

Town of Springfield, Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (1,357 ballots of 6,562 registered voters; certified by Town Clerk Barbara A. Courchesne and Assistant Town Clerk Carrie M. Kellow): Sharon Ayer (963 votes) and Chris Goding (946) won three-year library terms, and Britton Herring (1,070) won a two-year remainder term. The trustees page styles Goding 'L. Chris Goding'; the certified return's form governs the recorded name

Kellow): the three-year trustee contest had no ballot candidate; Sue Phelps was the highest write-in with 68 votes, and the town's trustees page records her as 'Elected: 3/5/2026, Term Expires: 2029' -- a write-in winner named in the certified tally with roster concurrence, recorded as elected (disclosed on issue #163)

Town of Springfield, Cemetery Commission page (current): Scott Page (Chair, term to 2027), Cathryn Feickert (to 2028), Ronald Griffin (to 2029), Judith Stern (to 2030); Barbara A. Courchesne sits ex officio and is not a member

Town of Springfield, Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (1,357 ballots of 6,562 registered voters; certified by Town Clerk Barbara A. Courchesne and Assistant Town Clerk Carrie M. Kellow): Beth Gray was re-elected Cemetery Commissioner for five years with 1,102 votes (term to 2031). The commission page's 'Beth Gray' is the justices listing's 'Elizabeth Gray' -- one person, recorded under the listing's form
